strings.name: Carlos Alberto Sicupira
strings.role: Brazilian investor and founding partner of 3G Capital
strings.summary: Carlos Alberto Sicupira is a Brazilian investor and a founding partner of 3G Capital. His long partnership with Jorge Paulo Lemann and Marcel Telles spans retail, beer and consumer businesses. He formerly led Americanas and left its board in 2024. Investigative allegations and his defense concerning knowledge of its accounting scandal must be distinguished.
strings.coverageNote: Reviewed through November 17, 2026, using the November 9 lawyers' statement and the company's governance roster as recent evidence. Board and committee roles, and group and personal investments, are distinguished. Investigation is not conviction; suspending an asset freeze is not an acquittal.
strings.influence.rationale: Participates in Brazilian retail, consumer businesses and 3G investments, influencing acquisition and management practices.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: He graduated in business administration from the Federal University of Rio de Janeiro. The graduation year was not verified in this review.
strings.facts.f2.label: Current role boundaries
strings.facts.f2.value: 3G is led by Alex Behring and Daniel Schwartz. Americanas currently lists him on its People, Management and Sustainability Committee, rather than its board.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Long-term investment partnership
strings.highlights.h1.text: His partnership with Lemann and Telles expanded from finance into retail and consumer investment. Joint acquisitions and business results cannot be attributed entirely to one person.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Support for public-management initiatives
strings.highlights.h2.text: He founded Brava, which supports public-sector management, digital education and social investment. These are institutional priorities, not independently verified claims of comprehensive impact.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Lawyers respond on the Americanas case
strings.timeline.t1.text: UOL publishes the three major shareholders' defense statement denying prior knowledge of fraud and describing them as victims. This is the lawyers' position, not a court finding.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Becomes a target of an investigative operation
strings.timeline.t2.text: Later reporting says the federal police investigation included him. The asset freeze was suspended in August, and he was not among the former executives charged in the October report. Neither conviction nor acquittal is inferred.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Leaves the Americanas board
strings.timeline.t3.text: He departs alongside Paulo Alberto Lemann. Leaving the board does not mean exiting all shareholdings or committees.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Helps establish 3G Capital
strings.timeline.t4.text: The firm develops from his investment office with Lemann and Telles. It is now led by co-managing partners Behring and Schwartz.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Founds Brava
strings.timeline.t5.text: The foundation supports improvements in public management and nonprofits. Its work later includes digital education and strategic social investment.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Participates in the Brahma control investment
strings.timeline.t6.text: The investment group formed with his partners gains control of the brewer, a step in subsequent beer-industry consolidation.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Takes on Americanas operating management
strings.timeline.t7.text: After Garantia invests in the retailer, he undertakes operational changes. This management milestone is not treated as the start of his chairmanship.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Joins Garantia
strings.timeline.t8.text: He enters finance and develops a partnership with Lemann and Telles, later expanding investment into operating businesses.
